candidates.name: Sarcoidosis with Ovarian and Bone Involvement

candidates.why: The combination of systemic symptoms, elevated ESR, lytic bone lesions, and bilateral pleural effusions suggests sarcoidosis, which can involve the ovaries and bones.
candidates.protected_reason: Sarcoidosis is a rare and multisystem disease that can be easily missed, especially in patients without a history of lung disease or malignancy.
